name: Parolu
blurb: Parolu allows you to generate audio from text using different voices.
description:
Parolu allows you to generate audio from text using different voices. This happens exclusively offline
on your device, your text is never sent to any third parties.

It's built on the Piper synthesizer library and supports voices for different languages including German,
Italian, French, Spanish, and even Esperanto!

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
